text.en: January 6, 2023. MPKV, Rahuri celebrated its 36th Convocation. Honourable Governor of Maharashtra and Chancellor of the university Shri.Bhagat Singh Koshyari presided over the function in online mode.  Vice Chancellor Dr. P. G. Patil presented the report of the university. Degrees to 104 Ph. D. holders, 628 Post Graduate holders and 10,736 Graduates and medals to successful students were conferred to the graduates. Many VIPs, former Vice Chancellors, EC members, officers, staff and students were present either in offline or online mode.

text.en: December 5, 2019. MPKV, Rahuri celebrated its 34th Convocation. Honourable Governor of Maharashtra and Chancellor of the university Shri. Bhagat Singh Koshyari presided over the function. Vice Chancellor Dr. K. P. Viswanatha presented the report of the university. Degrees to 52 Ph. D. holders, 308 Post Graduate holders and 4707 Graduates and medals to successful students were conferred to the graduates at the hands of Honourable Governor and Chancellor of the university.

text.en: 33th convocation of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri was held on 7/12/2018. The Chief Guest for the convocation was Shri. Nitinji Gadkari, Hon’ble Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, Shipping Water Resources, River Development and GangaRenovation, Govt. of India. The convocation speech was delivered by Dr.K.P.Viswanatha ,Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, M.P.K.V., Rahuri. 45 students received Ph D in different subjects while 356 and 4010 students received Masters and Bachelors degree in different subjects. 30 students were awarded the prizes during the convocation.
